run_final_cleaning_pipeline: run the final cleaning pipeline on a web document dataset by merging consecutive text nodes and filtering documents
run_node_level_cleaning: run func_map_final_cleaning_node_level to merge consecutive text nodes and remove empty text entries in a document example
run_doc_level_filtering: run func_filter_final_cleaning_doc_level to filter out documents that lack either text or images
extract_image_urls: extract and count all image URLs from the cleaned web document dataset metadata and save as a pickle file
save_cleaned_dataset: save the cleaned web document dataset to disk and sync it to an S3 bucket
